edges: User -> Web Portal : Request password reset (message)
Web Portal -> User : Check your email (message)
finalCode:
sequenceDiagram(name = "PasswordReset") {
    val user = lifeline(name = "User") { isActor = true }
    val portal = lifeline(name = "Web Portal")
    val authService = lifeline(name = "Auth Service")
    val database = lifeline(name = "User Database")
    val emailService = lifeline(name = "Email Service")

    message(from = user, to = portal, label = "Request password reset")
    message(from = portal, to = authService, label = "verifyEmail(email)")
    message(from = authService, to = database, label = "lookupUser(email)")
    reply(from = database, to = authService, label = "userRecord")

    message(from = authService, to = database, label = "storeResetToken(token)")
    message(from = authService, to = emailService, label = "sendResetEmail()")

    message(from = authService, to = portal, label = "success")
    message(from = portal, to = user, label = "Check your email")
}

edges: Token Cache -> API Gateway : cache miss (reply)
API Gateway -> Token Cache : storeToken(JWT, valid) (message)
Order Service -> API Gateway : order list (reply)
finalCode:
sequenceDiagram(name = "JWT Authentication Flow") {
    val client = lifeline(name = "Client") { isActor = true }
    val gateway = lifeline(name = "API Gateway")
    val cache = lifeline(name = "Token Cache")
    val authService = lifeline(name = "Auth Service")
    val orderService = lifeline(name = "Order Service")
    
    message(from = client, to = gateway, label = "GET /orders (JWT)")
    message(from = gateway, to = cache, label = "checkToken(JWT)")
    reply(from = cache, to = gateway, label = "cache miss")
    message(from = gateway, to = authService, label = "verifyToken(JWT)")
    reply(from = authService, to = gateway, label = "valid")
    message(from = gateway, to = cache, label = "storeToken(JWT, valid)")
    message(from = gateway, to = orderService, label = "GET /orders")
    reply(from = orderService, to = gateway, label = "order list")
    reply(from = gateway, to = client, label = "200 OK + orders")
}
